user.title: Add a Medisana BLE scale
user.description: Pick your scale from the list of Bluetooth devices Home Assistant has recently seen, or type its MAC address in manually if it isn't listed yet (the scale usually only advertises briefly right after a weigh-in).

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add Medisana scale
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name}?

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Medisana scales were found.

init.title: Medisana BLE scale options
init.description: Map the scale's built-in user slots (1-8, set on the scale itself) to names, so readings show up as sensors. Leave a slot blank to ignore it.
